reference: frozen phase2 full-vocabulary forward followed by selection of A/B logits
candidate: identical frozen decoder hidden states with only the two corresponding frozen linear lm_head rows evaluated

CPU_FP32.fixture: seeded tiny Llama, 3 synthetic physical-V EEG windows, unequal static prompt lengths, active EEG dropout with identical RNG reset

L4_BF16.fixture: actual pinned SmolLM2-1.7B, fixed train-only 3-window subset with both tasks, active EEG dropout with identical RNG reset

always_required: nonzero EEG encoder and projector gradients
all LLM parameters frozen with zero gradients
identical learned initial states and RNG
no held-out or validation waveform access
adoption_rule: Both CPU_FP32 and actual L4_BF16 must pass all fixed tolerances. Otherwise retain the original full-vocabulary head for phase3 training and inference.
interpretation: The restricted objective is mathematically unchanged. Device GEMM rounding can differ and is measured rather than assumed bit-identical. This guard establishes bounded numerical agreement, not model quality.
